rows.exclusions: Do not use one-way distance as round trip.

rows.title: Tree planter rental
rows.scope: Equipment rental only.
rows.exclusions: No seedlings, planting labour, tractor, transport or site preparation asserted included.

rows.title: Temporary bridge rental
rows.scope: One published rental set; three 4×30 ft sections or two 6×30 ft sections.
rows.exclusions: Contractor secures/transports; required insurance and installation are additional. Refundable deposit is separate cash requirement, not expense.

rows.title: Medium tractor: firebreak plowing / waterbar construction
rows.scope: First hour includes mileage charge for each unit per day; hourly service, not per-waterbar price.
rows.exclusions: Use a separate line for each tractor/day; fraction-of-hour billing policy requires confirmation.

rows.title: Large tractor: firebreak plowing / waterbar construction
rows.scope: First hour includes mileage charge for each unit per day; hourly service, not per-waterbar price.

rows.title: 391 — Bare-root, hand planted
rows.scope: Planting on a prepared riparian site; 12×12 ft spacing; minimum 35 ft buffer width.
rows.exclusions: Site preparation is not established as included; do not add duplicate seedlings/labour to this scenario.

rows.title: 391 — Bare-root, machine planted
rows.scope: Planting on a prepared riparian site; 12×12 ft spacing; minimum 35 ft buffer width.
rows.exclusions: Site preparation is not established as included; do not add duplicate seedlings/labour.

rows.title: 393 — Introduced Species
rows.scope: Filter strip seedbed preparation, seeding and seed.
rows.exclusions: Different scope from FY26 assistance rows that include foregone income; not interchangeable.

rows.title: 412 — Base Waterway - SE
rows.scope: Excavation and shaping; typical 1,200 ft length, 12 ft bottom, 8:1 sides, 1.5 ft depth.
rows.exclusions: Vegetation342, mulching484, drains606, outlets587/620 separately scoped; quantity is waterway area, not catchment area.

rows.title: 412 — With Checks - SE
rows.scope: Base waterway plus fabric/stone checks; typical geometry as original scenario.
rows.exclusions: Vegetation, mulching, drainage and outlet work separately scoped; do not also add Base Waterway scenario.

rows.title: 580 — Shaping
rows.scope: Bank shaping and critical vegetation; 6 ft bank, 3:1 slope, 500 linear ft typical.
rows.exclusions: Local engineering/permits/access/associated practices need review; not a per-acre price.

rows.title: 580 — Bioengineered
rows.scope: Shaping, vegetation, live stakes, rootwads and revetments; 6 ft bank, 3:1 slope typical.
rows.exclusions: Alternative scenario to shaping/structural; avoid overlapping component sums; site-specific design required.

rows.title: 580 — Structural
rows.scope: Shaping, vegetation, geotextile and rock riprap; 3 ft thick/5 ft high toe typical.
rows.exclusions: Alternative scenario, not additive to bioengineering; design, permits and access need project review.

rows.title: 590 — Prescription Nutrient Efficiency
rows.scope: Additional in-season soil/plant tests, equipment, labour, nutrient plan implementation and records.
rows.exclusions: Published scenario does not provide a lifecycle annual forecast; preserve user-selected actual recurrence.

rows.title: 590 — Nutrient Management
rows.scope: Nutrient management system implementation and recordkeeping for treated cropland.
rows.exclusions: Do not multiply by all watershed acreage or assume a repeated annual cost without an explicit planning basis.

rows.title: 655 — Trail Erosion Control w/o Vegetation
rows.scope: Rehabilitation of affected forest trail segments; heavy equipment and supervised drainage work.
rows.exclusions: Vegetation, stream crossing, access-road and water-control practices outside this scenario.

rows.title: 655 — Water Bars
rows.scope: Grading/shaping and installation; original typical Piedmont setting with 15% slopes.
rows.exclusions: Waterbar count requires surveyed/design spacing. Do not derive it directly from watershed or forest area.

quantity_policy.recurrence: Explicit user selection; never inferred from price unit or model annual-output unit
